rules.statement: Parol evidence can be used to establish an express or constructive trust when the surrounding circumstances indicate that the beneficial interest was not intended to pass, even if the conveyance is in form absolute.
rules.supporting_quote: A deed In those terms-transferring ownership of the half share to Ponnuthurai was necessary to effectuate the purpose for which Ponnuthurai wanted the plaintiff's assistance. The crucial issue, when the question is trust or no trust, is: What did the parties intend so far as their intention can be gathered from the surrounding circumstances?
